This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Why tanks turned into deafening death traps for their own crews. Inside the steel hull, engines roared, guns exceeded 150 dB, and hits sprayed spall while fires trapped men behind jammed hatches.

Hearing loss was almost inevitable. Escape was never guaranteed.
